subject: CLAIM texture-opus (variants, assigned by root): exact regions in air_bridge.rs and render_pipeline.inc
body: air_bridge.rs: (1) struct RenderPipelineHandle: add fields descriptor:Option<RenderPipelineDescriptor> and variants:Mutex<Vec<Box<VariantPipeline>>> + new struct VariantPipeline/impl right after impl RenderPipelineHandle; the constructors (create ~l.510, deserialize_render_handle, 2 test literals) get the fields. I do NOT touch cached_plan/cached_plan_mode/plan memo bodies; a variant has its own small plan cache. (2) generic_plan_mode: the line 'if !plan.variant.is_empty(){return Err(...)}' becomes a variant branch; handle._pipeline uses in generic_plan_mode / graphics_specialization_plan / graphics_stage_constants take a &RenderPipeline parameter (mechanical). (3) serialize/deserialize_render_handle: append compiled variants (RENDER_HANDLE_VERSION bump) so packs/disk caches carry them. (4) new FFIs tegu_air_render_pipeline_variant_spirv / _variant_count at the end of the render FFI block; air_bridge.h additions. render_pipeline.inc: only tegu_render_generic_variant_compile (use variant SPIR-V when spec->reserved[0]==1) + cache-entry re-store after a new variant (helper appended to pipeline_cache_frontend.inc). Tell me on the board if any region is in flight on your side; I re-read before every edit.
